title: Lyric Card
description: A lyric card that plays itself like an edit: each word cuts in on the beat of herb’s friday beat over grainy night photos, building a force-justified white block, a big Instrument Serif verse with an italic last line, or a small centred caption. Click for the next verse, save any verse as a PNG.
intent: Lyric typography taken all the way: deliberate justified blocks with even, generous gaps, a serif that sings, words cut in on an eighth-note grid, and almost no chrome so the card is the piece.
sources: herb reference board: lyric edits 859f, 899, e936 rain, 70e0 LA skyline, 0fc5 and ee6e justified blocks
